claims.statement: Shell ViewModels (PlayerViewModel, SettingsViewModel, AppMediaMetadataViewModel, PlaylistResumeViewModel, EmotionViewModel, MoodTimeSlotViewModel) must be created at AppRoot's Activity scope and passed into AppNavHost as parameters; calling viewModel() inside a NavHost composable block falls back to the non-Hilt SavedStateViewModelFactory and crashes for @HiltViewModel classes needing injected dependencies (regression recorded 2026-09-04 in source comments).

PlayerUiState.isLoading defaults to true and is cleared once the initial library load finishes (PlayerLibraryFacade.loadInitialData / the restore catch in PlayerRuntime), but it no longer gates composition: the if (uiState.isLoading) {} block in AppRoot is empty and the private LoadingSplash composable is dead code, so MusicplayerTheme, AppScaffold, AppNavHost, the player/queue overlays, and the error-message toasts (errorMessage to toast + clearError) compose from the first frame regardless of loading state.

SettingsViewModel exposes persisted StateFlows from PlayerSettingsRepository — themeMode (default SYSTEM), themeVariant (default MONO), screenOrientationMode (default SENSOR_AUTO), lyricFontScale (default 1f), each stateIn(WhileSubscribed(5_000)) with write-through setters — and AppRoot derives isDarkTheme from themeMode (SYSTEM → isSystemInDarkTheme), wraps the shell in MusicplayerTheme(darkTheme, variant), applies the screen orientation to the Activity via a LaunchedEffect, and syncs status-bar icon appearance via WindowCompat.getInsetsController.

MusicplayerTheme (core/ui theme/Theme.kt) resolves ThemeMode x ThemeVariant onto sixteen ThemeTokens presets via ThemeTokens.builtin(variant, dark) — the eight variants (MONO 墨色, VERMILION 朱砂, INDIGO 靛蓝静夜, SAGE 苔藓森野, AMBER 琥珀暖忆, SKY 天空澄明, FRESH 新叶青翠, SUNRISE 晨光霞粉 each with day/night) — mapped to a Material3 ColorScheme via tokensToColorScheme; dynamic color is disabled by default and LocalContentColor is explicitly provided as onSurface. Since 2026-10-24 theme mode / theme variant / screen orientation controls moved to the SKIN_SWITCHER skin-switcher page, where ThemeVariant.entries drives the ThemeVariantCard swatches (now in app/shell/SkinSwitcherRoute.kt) and each switch toasts the full display name (已切换为朱砂 · 心有乐章主题 etc.).

PermissionCoordinator.requestAudioFolderAccess silently requests READ_MEDIA_AUDIO only to accelerate scanning and ALWAYS launches the custom PersistableOpenDocumentTree folder picker regardless of grant/deny (onDenied also launches, no denied toast for the audio path); the contract adds FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION plus read/write grants so the picked SAF tree URI survives app restarts; the resulting URI flows to onFolderSelected → playerViewModel.importFolder(uri) with a count-based toast.

requestNotificationPermission/requestBluetoothConnectPermission consult RuntimePermissionPolicy (POST_NOTIFICATIONS only on Tiramisu+, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT only on S+, each with a user-facing denied message); an already-granted permission runs onGranted immediately, otherwise exactly one pending RuntimePermissionRequest continuation is stashed and launched — grant resumes it, denial routes the spec's deniedMessage to the shared toast — and a null spec short-circuits to onGranted on older OS versions; RuntimePermissionPolicyTest pins both cutoffs and messages.

Settings wires permission grants to player features (Bluetooth → initializeBluetoothPlayback, notification → setPlaybackNotificationEnabled(true), each with a success toast), and both permission requests must be user-triggered from Settings rather than at startup — a rule enforced by verifyProductArchitecture checking that the player startup facade contains no Bluetooth initialization and SettingsScreen keeps the 蓝牙播放监听/申请蓝牙权限 controls.

The shell owns a single rememberToastHost rendered as top-center ToastHost plus AutoDismissToasts(2000ms) above the NavHost; ToastHostState.showToast keeps only the latest entry (clearing prior ones), so attribution toasts replace rather than queue.

Lucky-play and infinite-play starts attribute mood-slot selection through the (started, moodSlotName) callback of PlayerViewModel.playRandomQueue / startInfinitePlay, not a currentMoodSlotName() poll: the AppRoot LuckyPlayEntryBar handler shows 已按「{slotName}」为你随机播放 and the now-playing surface's infinite play shows 已按「{slotName}」开启无限随机播放 (设计 doc §4.5 anti-attribution-difficulty); both settle the playlist source via playlistResumeViewModel.switchSource(null, …), and the now-playing lucky play shows the generic 已生成随机队列，开始播放~.

deleteSongWithToast runs PlayerViewModel.deleteSong on a shell coroutine scope because the call is suspending end-to-end: PlayerSongDeletionFacade → SongDeletionCoordinator → MusicRepository.deleteSong runs entirely inside withContext(Dispatchers.IO) — it performs the SAF DocumentFile cross-process delete (deleteBackingFile) before removing the song from songs/playlists, persisting, and (M-4) cleaning all missing-song associations (playback stats/events, quick-skip, short-play counts, emotion rows) — so the main thread is never blocked; DeleteSongResult.Success/Failure map directly to toasts.

AppRoutes is the single route-constant table (20+ destination routes including the HOME start destination, the SKIN_SWITCHER / FILE_CHECK / DUPLICATE_DETAIL pages, and parameterized playlist/{id}, artist/{name}, album/{name}, version-comparison/{groupId}, song-top-list?period patterns); parameterized routes must be built through its helper functions, which Uri.encode arguments (artist name, album name, group id) — call sites never concatenate route strings.

The removed compile-time AppDestinations enum is replaced by runtime AppShell derived from a skin description; the child-page-to-owning-tab mapping now lives in RouteAffinity.owningTopLevelRoute (pure function returning a top-level route string, supporting 2/3/5-item bottom bars), and this single mapping drives bottom-bar highlight via tabs.indexOfRoute(activeRoute), enter/exit/pop transitions by comparing tab ordinals (same-tab → no transition, pop transitions disabled), and edge-swipe tab paging via tabAt(activeRoute ± 1), which is disabled on the lyrics route.

AppScaffold adapts at a 600dp breakpoint (BoxWithConstraints maxWidth >= 600.dp) between a phone layout (content + MusicPlayerBottomBar mini-player shown when a song is loaded and the active route is not the player route, plus a bottom text nav bar) and a wide layout (left TextNavRail + content), with text-only bottom navigation a deliberately kept difference from the design mock.

Bottom-tab destinations navigate with the state-preserving recipe popUpTo(startDestination){saveState=true} + launchSingleTop + restoreState=true, so per-tab back stacks and UI state survive tab switches; AppRoot.onTabSelected and onNavigateToHome both use this recipe.

Each :feature:* module exposes only XxxRoute (a public composable taking XxxRouteState + XxxRouteActions + callbacks) plus an internal XxxScreen; AppNavHost is the sole place routes are wired and cross-feature jumps happen — verifyProductArchitecture (m-10, rules in buildSrc ProductArchitectureVerification) forbids feature-to-feature and :data/:player Gradle deps, demands the :feature:home / :feature:lyrics / :feature:settings / :feature:user pages each own a Route/Screen pair, and fails the build if the overlay-routing files (AppOverlay.kt / AppOverlayHost.kt / OverlayRoute.kt) are reintroduced.

Route-state derivation (playlistRouteState, userRouteState, playStatsRouteState, playbackStatsRouteState, songTopListRouteState, resolveResumeSong, flatGroupedSongs) is concentrated in pure, side-effect-free functions in AppRouteStateMappers.kt (documented as independently testable), while navigation/playback action assembly lives in AppRouteActionMappers.kt, keeping AppNavHost down to route table plus transitions.

Since P3 the O(n) grouped-and-flattened library is computed once at AppRoot level (sharedLibrarySongs = remember(uiState.songs) { flatGroupedSongs(...) }) and passed into AppNavHost as sharedLibrarySongs, then shared as precomputedLibrarySongs to playlist/detail/artist/album/stats/version routes and reused by the artist/album details rendered inside the player-sheet drawer (which is why it hoisted out of NavHost), eliminating per-recomposition regrouping on 1100+ song libraries; mappers fall back to internal computation only for legacy callers/tests.

positionMs (~500ms updates) and sleepTimerRemainingMs (1s ticks) are narrow StateFlows deliberately outside PlayerUiState so high-frequency ticks never recompose the whole shell (M-6 fix); only the destinations that need them subscribe — the now-playing/Home route (position + sleep timer), LyricsRoute (position), VersionComparisonRoute (seek bar).

Every click-a-song action queues through PlayerViewModel.playWith(song, SongPlaybackStrategy): SongPlaybackStrategy.single() queues only the clicked song (stats pages, local-music single click, staying on the page), while scope(list) queues the displayed group (playlist/artist/album/top list/quick-skip/version group) in sequential mode starting from the clicked song, replacing any existing queue.

PlaylistResumeViewModel.switchSource(newSource, currentSongId) settles the previous playlist source inside a single repository transaction — the library page always settles with a null source on song click, playlist detail passes its id only when the clicked song belongs to it, and onResumePlaylist plays the resolved song then clears the banner; resolveResumeSong nulls stale records whose song left the playlist or is unplayable (uri == null), covered by ResolveResumeSongTest.

AppRoot provides LocalEmotionCorrectionController once above the scaffold, delegating save to AppMediaMetadataViewModel.saveEmotionCorrection: an empty word set restores auto tags (clearCorrection, requires an existing row); a non-empty set is rejected outright when any word is outside EmotionGroup — since 2026-10-24 avgOfWords is not used as the validator because it silently drops illegal words — and isUserCorrection(modelTagsOf(it), words) records whether the mark is a real disagreement with the model conclusion versus an accept; repository bridges run on Dispatchers.Default. It refreshes EmotionViewModel on success and toasts 这首歌还没完成分析 on failure, so any page rendering SongInfoDialog/SongEmotionSection gains the 不像？标记 capability without callback threading.

The emotion-analysis page derives failed-song rows with a produceState keyed on the failure fingerprint + songs list + a local calibrationVersion; because manual marks do not change the failure record (attempts/failedAt unchanged), onCalibrateSong reads the controller via LocalEmotionCorrectionController (composable context) and increments calibrationVersion after a successful save to force a requery (2026-09-04 regression where the list only updated after leaving the page); marking a failed song without an analysis row creates a user-only record through the shared controller.

MoodTimeSlotViewModel observes TimeSlotConfigRepository configs, the persisted RandomEnhanceMode (randomEnhanceMode StateFlow, OFF/TIME_SLOT/EXPLORE), and word-preferences list; loadStats() computes tag-to-song counts and library size once per config-page entry on Dispatchers.IO (degrading badges to zero on failure); matchCount() sums songs whose per-word ratio clears the MoodSlotPolicy.MATCH_MIN_RATIO gate through a per-tag-set cache (M-15, so typing in the edit dialog no longer triggers a full-library scan per keystroke); save() reports overlap/zero-length validation errors through a (Boolean, String?) callback surfaced as toasts, setMode switches the exclusive enhance mode with a SelectMode toast, and clearWordPreferences resets explore word counts.

Repository calls reached from composition (songInfo loading, playback-stats snapshots per review C-2, ranked counts, calibrated tags) are wrapped in runCatching with safe defaults because the underlying Room runBlocking bridge throws; failures are logged via AppLog and degrade to null/EMPTY values instead of crashing the coroutine.

PlayerQueueSheetHost renders PlayQueueSheet above the scaffold, driven by AppRoot-local showQueueSheet state with an AppRoot BackHandler; selecting a song plays that queue index and dismisses the sheet, and removal/clear emit confirmation toasts.

Since 2026-10-20 the 随心播放增强 feature is driven by the persisted RandomEnhanceMode enum (OFF/TIME_SLOT/EXPLORE) surfaced by MoodTimeSlotViewModel.randomEnhanceMode for the config page; PlayerRuntime observes the same repository flow to set PlayerUiState.isExploreModeActive and, when the mode leaves EXPLORE during a running session, calls randomQueueFacade.stopExplorePlay() to exit it immediately.

Explore play (RandomEnhanceMode.EXPLORE) is carried by PlayerRandomQueueFacade: playRandomQueue generates a fixed 10-song batch and sets isExplorePlay on PlayerUiState (surfaced as HomeRouteState.isExplorePlay, which also gates HomeRoute's onInfinitePlayClick); infinite random play is disabled while an explore session runs — the HomeRoute onInfinitePlayClick instead opens the 探索播放中 dialog — and the queue auto-refills 5 songs via refillExplorePlayQueue favoring liked / avoiding disliked words when the batch runs low; explore listen feedback accumulates WordPreference votes into wordPreferenceCache via short-skip detection.

The player's mood-slot/enhance data is no longer a startup-only snapshot (M-2, review 2026-10-15): PlayerRuntime.observeMoodSlotCaches continuously subscribes to TimeSlotConfigRepository.observeConfigs(), SongEmotionRepository.observeAll() (mapped on Dispatchers.Default), WordPreferenceRepository.observeAll(), and the randomEnhanceMode flow — the single emotion subscription derives two ratio distributions (full match for pool matching, and a gated vote distribution for explore vote counting). The mode is cached into a @Volatile randomEnhanceModeCache (review 2026-10-27 N-3), so PlayerRandomQueueFacade reads moodSlotEnabled == TIME_SLOT and exploreModeEnabled == EXPLORE as zero-IO reads consistent with isExploreModeActive; config saves/deletes, new emotion analyses/calibrations, and mode switches take effect without a restart, and the old manual onConfigsChanged/refreshMoodSlots seam no longer exists.
